RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Question for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the July 17, 2002/Asadha 26, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Coal and Mines; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional
Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
————
Total number of questions—57
26
Non-freezing drink for soldiers
developed by defence scientists
†100. DR. ABRAR AHMED: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that defence
scientists have developed a drink for the
soldiers keeping round the clock vigil on
snow covered mountains and which does
not freeze even at a temperature of minus
twenty degree;
(b) if so, whether the said drink has been
tested; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Defence purchases from countries
supportive to national interests
101. SHRI RAJNATH SINGH
'SURYA': Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
make defence procurements from only those
countries who espouse our national interest
internationally;
(b) if so, the reasons and details thereof;
and
(c) if not, whether Government propose
to consider such a proposal in near future?
Fire/accidents in Ordnance Depots
102. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
cases of fire in ordnance factories and
accidents in transportation of arms and
ammunition have taken place after the failure
of Agra Summit in 2001;
(b) if so, the details thereof indicating
the quantity and value of the loss of arms
and ammunition besides property and
human lives lost in each case;
(c) whether any sabotage has been
established in these cases;
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
what were the causes of these accidents;
and
(e) what extra precautionary steps have
been taken to stop recurrence of such cases?
Utilisation of National Defence Fund
103. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the total amount of deposit in the
National De fence Fund up to December
2001 including interest accrued thereupon;

for various purposes and future plans, if
any;
(c) whether the remaining amount could
be reserved for future utilisation to help
families of those defence personnel who
sacrificed their lives during earlier wars and
extremist attack; and
(d) if so,the details thereof?
Indo-US joint war exercises in Agra
104. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian and
Special Forces troops from the United States
conducted joint war games in the backyard
of the Taj Mahal in Agra; and
(b) if so, the salient features and the main
objectives of the exercises and the outcome
thereof?
Indigenous production of arms
105. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as per the
report of Stockholm International Peace
Research Institute (SIPRI) India ranks fifth
among the first ten countries in the world in
import of armaments in the year 2001;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the concrete steps being taken to
produce more arms indigenously?
Delay in induction of Sukhoi Jets in
IAF
106. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for delay in expeditious
induction of the latest Sukhoi Fighter
aircrafts in the Indian Air Force;
(b) the steps taken by Government to
reduce the induction time; and
(c) by when the requisite number of
Sukhoi MKI aircrafts will be inducted in
the Indian Air Force?
Indo-Russia joint defence production
107. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-report published in
the ‘Asian Age’ dated 4th May, 2002 under
the caption, “India moots joint defence
production with Russia”;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the specific advantages which would
accrue to India in adopting joint programme
of development and production of defence
equipment with Russia?
Purchase of Sniffer dogs
108. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a team of
officials had rushed to Hyderabad to
purchase a large number of sniffer dogs;
(b) if so, what is the background of
raising such an unprecedented demand of
special dogs instantly; and
(c) how long did it take to clear the
proposal and how much fund would be
required?
